text: You're the one the Director brought in. Don't tell me anything. Knowing things is how you end up in an interview room.
style: A junior SAFETYNET analyst in her mid-twenties who has not slept, watching a mole hunt happen around her desk. British-Indian, from Leicester: a consistent East Midlands accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Soft, slightly high pitch; quick, quiet pace. Nervy, oversharing out of stress.
